title: Listener
description: The edge between a signal type and one consumer (everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md): the type range it hears, the consumer's criterion, and what happens to a signal that meets it. Noise is not a property of a signal: it is the outcome of one signal at one listener, so the same signal can be salient at one consumer and noise at another. A listener is not a file of its own. Listeners merge, like triggers, from naive.config.json listeners (a same-id listener replaces any other), each installed package's listeners, each frame's listens and each listed kit's listeners; naive.config.json listeners_off turns one off. The types a pull reads are derived from the listeners, so there is no subscription list. Nothing merges or evaluates listeners yet: that is a later build item.

id.description: Unique among the venture's listeners once merged; a same-id listener in naive.config.json replaces any other

hears.description: The signal type range it hears (competitor-funding@^1). A listener for a part's type hears that part of every composite that has it

consumer.description: What the listener serves: a record route (then project, or revalidate), a frame or a decision (then propose). Required in naive.config.json and in packages; a frame's listener serves that frame and leaves it out

route.description: A record route, where [id] is the signal's subject: competitors/[id]/signals

decision.description: The decision it proposes; the proposal's id is this id, a hyphen and the signal's subject

then.description: What a salient signal does. project: folds into the consumer route by the type's projects (level: it reads no clock, so no max_age). propose: proposes a decision. revalidate: marks the consumer stale. propose and revalidate are edge listeners and may judge a signal's age against now

max_age.description: Edge listeners only: a signal older than this is noise here. Overrides the type's freshness.max_age

criterion.description: The consumer's own threshold, after signal detection theory (Green and Swets 1966). A signal is salient when it passes every part; otherwise it is noise at this listener, and every failed part is reported. Checked in this order: rating, producers, age (edge listeners only), then every predicate

rating.description: The worst rating accepted: a signal whose reliability letter or credibility number is past either bound is noise

producers.description: Accepted producer prefixes; any producer when left out

id.description: Named in explain when it fails

field.description: The view field it tests: props.round.amount, subject

op.description: contains: the field is a list holding the value, or a string holding it. exists takes no value

why.description: Why this consumer cares, in words, printed by explain

operand.description: A literal (a scalar, or a list of scalars for in and not-in); one field of one venture record read through the router ({ "read": "foundation/icp.json#markets" }); or the ids of projected records ({ "ids": "competitors" }). Every fact a predicate reads is cited in the write's derived_from

read.description: A venture file and one field in it: foundation/icp.json#markets

ids.description: A collection of projected records: competitors
